name: Abdurauf Fitrat
role: Uzbek writer, politician and public intellectual
contribution: An Uzbek author, journalist, politician and public intellectual in Central Asia under Russian and Soviet rule.

checks.lead: Abdurauf Fitrat (sometimes spelled Abdulrauf Fitrat or Abdurrauf Fitrat, Uzbek: Abdurauf Fitrat / Абдурауф Фитрат; 1886 – 4 October 1938) was an Uzbek author, journalist, politician and public intellectual in Central Asia under Russian and Soviet rule.
